purpose: Compare caller-supplied public/package records, versions, claims, or evidence references and report declared inconsistency, missing evidence, stale version, or non-authority boundary issues.
trigger_conditions: The caller names this review perspective.
The caller supplies only declared public/package records, versions, claims, or evidence references.
The requested output is a bounded finding list, not an edit or conflict decision.
prohibited_actions: Do not retrieve network material or open an undeclared/private source.
Do not edit the audited object or resolve a conflict without a human choice.
Do not infer scientific truth, access permission, compliance, ethics, DUA, human identity, or authorization.
Do not approve a Gate, Release, submission, or another role.
human_decision_points: A human selects the records and evidence references to compare.
A human chooses the repair or disposition when a contradiction is found.
A human decides any Release, installation, scientific, compliance, Gate, or submission consequence.
stop_and_escalation_conditions: Stop if a source is undisclosed, private, external, or requires network retrieval.
Stop if the request asks to edit, publish, install, or resolve a conflict without a human choice.
Stop if evidence is missing or an authoritative record contradicts another record; report the bounded conflict and options instead.

audit_record_requirements.record_location_policy: Record the declared compared inputs, findings, unknowns, options, and accountable-human decision point in a caller-designated permitted audit record.

explicit_non_claims: This is not an agent runtime.
This is not delegated authority or an independent AI actor.
This is not a tool grant, M53 bounded-autonomy authorization, helper admission, or per-run write confirmation.
This is not external evidence retrieval.
This is not a compliance determination.
This is not a Gate transition.
This is not a Release authority.
This is not a submission authority or an automatic task initiator.
